device.model: APT motion controller (MTS50, PRM1 or LTS300 stage)
device.name: Thorlabs APT stage controller (pyapt)

facts.text: The Controller opens the FTDI device and sets its baud rate to 115200
The FTDI line is configured for 8 data bits, 1 stop bit and no parity
MTS50, PRM1 and LTS300 are subclasses of Controller that set the stage scales and travel range
The base Controller defines linear_range as the linear distance range in mm with a conservative (0, 50) default
LTS300 sets its linear range to 0 to 300 mm
PRM1 sets its linear range to -180 to 180, the rotation range in degrees
status() returns the position and velocity of the controller, and its docstring says those are in mm and mm/s
position() converts the raw encoder count with position_scale and returns the real-world position
goto() raises OutOfRangeError when soft limits are enabled and the target is outside linear_range
move() reads the current position and calls goto() with the relative target
home() reuses the current homing parameters, changes the velocity and offset, sends SET_HOMEPARAMS and MOVE_HOME, and waits for MOVE_HOMED when wait is true
set_soft_limits() sets whether the controller observes range limits in software
set_velocity_parameters() clamps acceleration and maximum velocity to the controller attributes and sends SET_VELPARAMS
velocity_parameters() returns minimum velocity, acceleration and maximum velocity in real-world units
stop() sends MOVE_STOP; immediate true stops immediately, otherwise it stops in a profiled manner, and wait false returns after sending
The upstream README warns that stage limits quoted on the Thorlabs website or user manuals often do not agree with reality and recommends the APT User software limits
reset_parameters() restores the EEPROM defaults and only the BPC30x series appears to support it
keepalive() sends the server-alive message, which must be sent at least once a second over USB

operator_required.name: position
operator_required.reason: the travel range depends on the stage model: MTS50 0 to 50 mm (pyAPT/mts50.py:31), LTS300 0 to 300 mm (pyAPT/lts300.py:31) and PRM1 -180 to 180 degrees (pyAPT/prm1.py:35); the operator supplies the range of the installed stage in its own unit

operator_required.name: maximum_velocity
operator_required.reason: the velocity limit depends on the stage model and the upstream README warns that limits quoted by Thorlabs often do not agree with reality (README.md:15-19); the operator supplies the velocity ceiling of the installed stage in its own unit per second

operator_required.name: acceleration
operator_required.reason: the acceleration limit depends on the stage model and the upstream README warns that limits quoted by Thorlabs often do not agree with reality (README.md:15-19); the operator supplies the acceleration ceiling of the installed stage in its own unit per second squared

operator_required.name: home
operator_required.reason: the native home() takes a velocity and clamps it to the controller's max_velocity (pyAPT/controller.py:262-264), while the class's 0 to 1 speed_scale is a catalogue bound and not a bound of the installed stage; the operator supplies the fraction of the configured maximum velocity this site allows

operator_required.name: move_relative
operator_required.reason: a relative move is bounded by the current position and the travel range of the installed stage, which the native goto checks when soft limits are enabled (pyAPT/controller.py:325-326); the operator supplies the distance range in the stage unit

safe_state.description: stage motion stopped by the native stop with the immediate flag
